scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @engageplus/api" "npm run dev -w @engageplus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @engageplus/api && npm run build -w @engageplus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @engageplus/api && npm run typecheck -w @engageplus/web && tsc -p tests --noEmit
